_note: Synthetic data for the AGENTHON demo. Filare Labs is a fictional company; every person, client, supplier, amount and address here is made up. No real client or personal data. Copied from the repo-root data/ and extended for the best-of-three build (approvers, overview, audiences, stripe, demo).

company.name: Filare Labs S.r.l.
company.what: IoT soil and weather sensors for vineyards in Piedmont, sold as a yearly subscription

access_rule: A person can see an item if the item's acl contains any of the person's groups, or if the person is in 'exec'. Enforced in code before any model call.
approval_rule: The CEO decides everything, and is the only one who decides company-wide facts (acl 'all'). Otherwise you must see the fact and hold an approver role for one of the teams it belongs to. Money facts (finance) always need the CFO.

overview.about: Filare Labs makes IoT soil and weather sensors for vineyards in Piedmont. Wineries pay a yearly subscription for the sensors, the gateways and the frost and irrigation alerts.
offer: Yearly sensor subscription (Starter: up to 30 sensors; Estate: up to 80)
Gateways that collect the sensors' data on site
Frost and soil-moisture alerts for the agronomist
Field support: an engineer within 2 working days for an outage
how: Sensors in the plots, one gateway for up to 60 sensors
Firmware updates only in planned windows
Weekend on-call field support in frost season (November to April)
A customer can pause a renewal with 30 days' notice
overview.where: Torino, with customers in the Langhe, Roero and Monferrato
